about.title: Trusted Automotive Audio & Infotainment Manufacturing Partner
about.subtitle: End-to-End Automotive Electronics Manufacturing: From Conceptual Engineering, Rigorous QA Testing, High-Speed SMT, to Tariff-Free Global Supply Chains.
about.description1: PT. Global Philsonic Technologies (GPT) is a dedicated automotive electronics manufacturing facility under the PT. Intersis Sejahtera Abadi group, located at Komplek Tanah Mas Blok L No.2, Batam Free Trade Zone (FTZ), Indonesia.
about.description2: Our mission: To deliver high-quality, competitively priced, and tariff-advantaged products (Car Amplifiers, Subwoofers, DSPs, Android Headunits, Dashcams) and industrial automation solutions to global markets and partners, especially the USA.
about.highlight1Title: Tariff Mitigation & C/O Made in Indonesia
about.highlight1Desc: Mitigate US import tariff exposure with verified Certificate of Origin compliance.
about.highlight2Desc: 0% import duty on raw electronic materials and direct 45-minute maritime link to Singapore ports.
about.highlight3Desc: Audited quality control, climate-controlled cleanroom lines, and zero-defect focus.

lifecycle.title: Design & Engineering Excellence
lifecycle.lead: Global Philsonic Technologies has a powerful Design & Engineering team focused on R&D and electronic manufacturing services (EMS). From initial concept to mass production, we fully understand customer requirements.
lifecycle.description: With an experienced group of R&D professionals, we provide flexible and dedicated technical support. Factors relating to the product life cycle, including manufacturability, cost-efficiency, and rapid prototyping, are thoroughly optimized to accelerate time-to-market.
points: Embedded Software, Android OS & DSP Acoustic Algorithms

lifecycle.title: Rigorous Quality & Reliability Assurance
